title: Tyr
provenance: Reported by stefanlight8 (highball-db#1420, 2026-11-23), Apple M1, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after 1 minute: with the Steam id given, AVX advertised, a 60 fps cap and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes. The game crashes on its first start and not after that. The player had played about 120 hours before on CrossOver 26.1 with D3DMetal and found it much the same. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Stoke Games' free to play multiplayer tank shooter, in Early Access. Reported perfect on a base M1 with D3DMetal on the default engine r28 in a one minute session, from a player with about 120 hours on CrossOver 26.1. It crashes on its first start and runs after that.

knownIssues.symptom: The game crashes on its first start, and not on later ones (M1, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1420)
knownIssues.fix: start it again, by the reporter
